verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs say you can decide which actions need approval, and agents are defined in a YAML config. This implies approval requirements are configurable, so in principle no actions would need confirmation. However, nothing explicitly documents an 'auto-approve all' mode or how to set it. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented auto-approve-all setting, config/CLI syntax for approval policies, and independent or hands-on confirmation that approvals can be disabled entirely.
